memberdef.name: syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane

briefdescription.para: Plan a Circular or Helical arc move in a selectable right-handed plane.

detaileddescription.para:
Plane axis mapping follows NIST RS-274 right-handed cyclic permutations:
0 (G17 XY): primary (X, Y) with offsets (I, J), linear axis Z.
1 (G18 ZX): primary (Z, X) with offsets (K, I), linear axis Y.
2 (G19 YZ): primary (Y, Z) with offsets (J, K), linear axis X.

parameterdescription.para: Center offset relative to start (I, J, K).
Working plane selector (0 = XY, 1 = ZX, 2 = YZ).
true for Clockwise, false for Counter-Clockwise in the selected plane.
Spatial resolution per step (units per step).

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM on invalid arguments.
